notes: וּבָנִים לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ is rule 43's written-הָיָה case: *had* on the verb, *he* on the suffix, *no* on the negative recast onto the nominal (rule 15), and the possessive לְ unrepresented (rule 40).

הַנּוֹעָדִים is recast as *them that gathered themselves together*; the supplied noun phrase including the *of* is kept with the substantival article under rule 41, and that unit's note names the competing reading that leaves *of them* to the participle (rule 8).
מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה: the reflexive *themselves* and the particle *together* render the Niphal's own voice and sense and stay with the participle (rule 44).
